merchandise.name: Bakerz Bite Ceramic Mug
merchandise.shortDescription: Stoneware mug with the house wordmark, dishwasher safe.
merchandise.description: A chunky stoneware mug glazed in our house cream with the Bakerz Bite wordmark pressed into the side. Thick walls keep a cappuccino hot to the last mouthful, and the handle is sized for a whole hand rather than two fingers.

merchandise.name: Bakerz Bite Canvas Tote
merchandise.shortDescription: Heavy cotton canvas tote with reinforced straps.
merchandise.description: Cut from 12 oz unbleached cotton canvas with box-stitched straps that will carry a full weekend shop without complaint. Screen printed by hand with the Bakerz Bite mark, so no two are identical.

merchandise.name: Bakerz Bite Tumbler Glass
merchandise.shortDescription: Etched tumbler for iced coffee and cold brew.
merchandise.description: A weighted-base tumbler with the Bakerz Bite monogram acid-etched rather than printed, so it will never wash off. Sized for a full iced latte with room for ice.

merchandise.name: Bakerz Bite Serving Tray
merchandise.shortDescription: Oiled acacia tray with routed handles.
merchandise.description: Solid acacia with a food-safe oil finish and handles routed straight into the board rather than screwed on. Big enough for a cake stand and four cups, light enough to carry one-handed.

merchandise.name: Bakerz Bite Baker's Apron
merchandise.shortDescription: Cross-back canvas apron with a split front pocket.
merchandise.description: The same apron our bakers wear. Cross-back straps take the weight off your neck, and the split front pocket holds a bench scraper and a thermometer without either falling out when you lean over.

specifications.Pockets: Split front pocket, side towel loop

merchandise.name: Bakerz Bite Gift Box
merchandise.shortDescription: Rigid presentation box with ribbon and gift card.
merchandise.description: A rigid kraft box lined with greaseproof paper, finished with a grosgrain ribbon and a blank card for your message. Fills with any twelve cookies or macarons of your choosing.

specifications.Includes: Grosgrain ribbon and blank gift card
